metadata.description: DIA-NN outputs of every quantmsdiann reanalysis in the manuscript (ProteoBench modules 5, 7, 9, 10; single-cell, spatial, phosphoproteomics and bulk cell-line cohorts; PXD071075 scalability run) and the paired standalone DIA-NN vs quantmsdiann runs (PXD049412, PXD070049). Files are named <dataset>_<diann-version>_<file>. Per run: DIA-NN report (parquet/tsv), precursor/protein/gene matrices, stats, SDRF, diann_config.cfg, Nextflow parameters and trace. raw_files.tsv lists every raw file processed with its URL in the original ProteomeXchange/MassIVE deposit. The 44 GB ProCan (PXD030304) DIA-NN report is deposited only in PRIDE (see related identifier); all other files are here.
